name: revenue-quant-smoke
domain: quantitative analysis of tabular financial data: distributions, trends, outliers, and the arithmetic that supports or refutes them. NOT strategy, NOT causal explanation, NOT recommendations.

problem.context: shared/transactions.csv holds 6 months of per-order revenue with columns: order_id, date, region, channel, gross_revenue, discount, refunded (bool). It is a small file (under 40 rows) - read all of it.
problem.goal: Quantify the Q3 vs Q2 revenue change and identify which region/channel accounts for it.
success_criteria: A single headline number for the Q3 vs Q2 change, with its definition stated (net of refunds and discounts).
A breakdown by region and channel identifying the largest contributor to the change.
Every number reproducible by running a script left in the output directory.
Any data-quality issue found (nulls, duplicate order_ids) reported in unknowns rather than silently handled.

miscellaneous.note: Prior analyses disagreed because some included refunded orders. State your treatment explicitly.
